# Golden path: sync pulls verbatim bytes and records both digests; status
# classifies; publish is explicit, noted, deduped, and refuses broken JSON.

fulcrum sync
grep 'synced estimation-rubric.json' last-stdout.txt
grep 'synced estimation-rubric.md' last-stdout.txt
cmp skills/estimation-rubric.json $CORPUS/documents/estimation-rubric.json
cmp skills/estimation-rubric.md $CORPUS/documents/estimation-rubric.md
grep 'remote_digest' skills/.fulcrum-sync.json
grep '"version": 1' skills/.fulcrum-sync.json

fulcrum status
grep 'synced' last-stdout.txt
! grep 'drifted' last-stdout.txt

fulcrum cat estimation-rubric
cmp last-stdout.txt $CORPUS/documents/estimation-rubric.md

fulcrum version
grep 'fulcrum test' last-stdout.txt

# Local edit flips the row to drifted and the exit code to 1.
cp edited.json skills/estimation-rubric.json
fulcrum -code 1 status
grep 'drifted' last-stdout.txt

# Declining sends nothing — and exits 0.
fulcrum -in decline.txt publish
grep 'Nothing published' last-stdout.txt
srv count 0

# Confirm + note submits, with the last-sync digest as the base.
fulcrum -in confirm.txt publish
grep 'Proposal #101 submitted' last-stdout.txt
srv count 1
grep '"id": 101' skills/.fulcrum-sync.json

# Submitted bytes classify as proposed (fresh), and a second publish no-ops.
fulcrum status
grep 'proposed' last-stdout.txt
fulcrum -in confirm.txt publish
grep 'Nothing published' last-stdout.txt
srv count 1

# Invalid JSON is refused per document; nothing submitted.
cp broken.json skills/estimation-rubric.json
fulcrum -in confirm.txt publish
grep 'not valid JSON, nothing submitted' last-stdout.txt
srv count 1

-- edited.json --
{
  "rubric_id": "org-default",
  "status": "edited-locally"
}
-- broken.json --
{ broken
-- decline.txt --
n
-- confirm.txt --
y
Widened per client call
